segments.text: Ok so, this is the markdown mode page in the CopilotKit docs, for LangGraph TypeScript, and I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, the provider from the doc.
So I asked for a card with a seats slider and a price label.
The agent says here's a card, but uh, no card renders in the chat.

And for other agents, it just says to put the run's context into the system prompt.
So basically, I did exactly that in a small harness graph, since the docs show no TypeScript agent.
And the card rendered only in three out of five runs. The others just say here's a card, and umm, nothing shows up.
Okay, so kindly fix this one as well.
